title: Shipping a laptop to a refugee camp in Uganda
summary: A personal narrative about shipping a laptop to a refugee camp in Uganda, detailing the logistics, challenges, and impact of providing technology access to displaced people. The article explores personal initiative in bridging the digital divide for humanitarian purposes.
problem_solved: Provides digital access and educational opportunities to refugees who lack technology infrastructure in Uganda.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how individual tech contributions can create meaningful impact in underserved communities while documenting practical lessons for similar humanitarian tech efforts.
